name: Free Activation Milestone Product Roadmap PowerPoint Template
description: An editable product roadmap for improving user onboarding, first value, sustained use, and release readiness.
longDescription: This original eight-slide activation milestone product roadmap turns an onboarding problem into a measurable product plan. It covers the user friction, outcome, evidence, priority bets, staged delivery, release checks, risks, and the next decision. A stepped signal-column system and warm ivory, ink, copper, and mint native PowerPoint shapes make the planning logic easy to edit. Every sample metric is an illustrative placeholder and should be replaced with verified product data.
cover: Make first value easier to reach
An editable product plan from onboarding friction to release evidence.

story.title: Users meet effort before value
story.body: Map where a new user pauses, asks for help, or leaves before completing a meaningful task.

story.title: Choose one activation outcome
story.body: Name the task that demonstrates value, its measurement window, and the audience it serves.

story.title: Separate signal from assumption
story.body: Combine an illustrative funnel with user observations; validate both before prioritizing work.

story.title: Build for the next useful action
story.body: Rank proposed changes by likely user value, uncertainty, and delivery cost.

story.title: Release in measurable steps
story.body: Sequence a small test, controlled rollout, and wider release around evidence gates.

story.title: Protect trust during the change
story.body: Watch for misleading progress, excess prompts, and improvements that shift work to support.

story.title: Agree on the next release gate
story.body: Close with an owner, a validated metric, and the evidence required to approve wider rollout.
